quarterly_data.quarter: Quantinuum press release: Quantinuum Breaks Error-Correction World Record by 10x, (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Quantinuum reported a world-record quantum error-correction result on its Helios commercial computer: a logical fidelity of 99.9995% (five errors per million operations) using a color code within its error-correction architecture - an error rate 10 times lower than its own September 2026 record (Helix code) and, per the company, 100 times lower than the best published result on other modalities (Google Quantum AI, superconducting); each tested code-distance increase cut logical errors by a factor of 12. Helix used 10 physical qubits per logical qubit versus up to 37 for the color code. The company says the accuracy is now within the target range for Apollo, its planned universal fault-tolerant computer expected to be available by 2029. CEO Raj Hazra: 'We've crossed the threshold necessary for exponential improvements in accuracy.'
quarterly_data.figure: 99.9995% logical fidelity; 10x lower error than the September 2026 record; Apollo by 2029
